answer: Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the dawn log exposes the live set and the knoll audit records each lapse. Keeping 195 aliases alive therefore means 195 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the summit quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 199 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
